description: Deterministic B0, B1, and B2 catalog execution with the shared Phase 07/T1 metric field set. Adapter contact and transmission semantics remain provisional and are not publication evidence.

adapter_rules.contact_window: Each deterministic catalog scenario is represented as one discrete adapter contact. This is a measurement adapter, not a claim about operational timing.
adapter_rules.schedule_identity: SHA-256 covers scenario ID, baseline variant, initial state, compromise scope, activation policy, and normalized fault actions.
adapter_rules.seed: Null because baseline catalog scenarios are deterministic and not seed-generated.
adapter_rules.transmissions: Declared scenario-level attempted-message counts used only for internal parity diagnostics.
adapter_rules.retry_overhead: Attempted transmissions above the declared no-fault reference for the baseline variant.
adapter_rules.command_and_telemetry: Adapter-derived evidence fields; no concrete command protocol or operational telemetry is implemented.
adapter_rules.oracle_check: Every emitted row must match the existing catalog alignment, joint-state when declared, and outcome oracle.
